answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The harbor is the quoted measurement, the sonnet the group it forms, and the tide the voice that group is worth; the harbor and the sonnet collapse a farm, while only a fresh tide of hardware escapes the grouping.
